selected.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NovaSeq, TruSeq stranded mRNA), HISAT2 alignment, FPKM (S5.4.p1, GEO data_processing)
selected.samples: male C57BL/6 mice, young (9 wk) and old (84 wk), control or 4 weeks treadmill exercise; n=3 mice per group; soleus (SOL) and gastrocnemius (GAS) from each mouse; 24 libraries (S5.1.p1)
selected.primary_estimand: Effect of 4 weeks of treadmill exercise on gene expression within each muscle (SOL, GAS) and age group: YE vs YC and OE vs OC, separately in SOL and GAS
planned_contrasts: SOL YE/YC (S2.3.p1; paper: 31 DEGs, 11 up / 20 down)
GAS YE/YC (S2.3.p1; paper: 13 DEGs, 7 up / 6 down)
SOL OE/OC (S2.4.p1; paper: 20 DEGs, 10 up / 10 down)
GAS OE/OC (S2.4.p1; paper: 13 DEGs, 6 up / 7 down)
selected.non_exercise_contrasts_in_paper: OC/YC per tissue (aging, S2.2.p1: 196 SOL, 119 GAS) and SOL vs GAS per group (S2.5.p1, p<0.05 & FC>2); not part of the exercise estimand
selected.normalization: FPKM -> +1, log2, quantile normalization with preprocessCore (S5.5.p1)
selected.paper_method: independent t-test per gene on the pre-processed data, Bioconductor genefilter (S5.6.2.p1); each comparison uses only its two groups
selected.repeated_measure_unit: mouse (SOL and GAS from the same animal; sample suffixes match across tissues); not relevant within a tissue
selected.paper_results: Tables 2-3 named genes: Nr1d1 down in SOL and GAS YE/YC; Pik3r1 up SOL / down GAS YE/YC; Pnpla3 up in both OE/OC; Hbb-b1 up SOL / down GAS OE/OC; Chtop down SOL / up GAS OE/OC. GSEA Hallmark (Tables 9, 11-13).

decisions.reason: Methods S5.5.p1 and S5.6.2.p1 give the preprocessing, test and threshold (p < 0.05, FC > 1.5 for within-tissue comparisons). Results S2.3.p1 and S2.4.p1 give the exercise DEG counts. The aging and SOL-vs-GAS comparisons are not exercise effects and are left out.

Exact match of matrix column names to the metadata description (N_SOL_YC-1 ...), as inspect reported 24/24. tissue, group (YC/YE/OC/OE) and mouse id are parsed from the description; groups agree with source_name_ch1 (e.g. 'soleus of young control').

selected.source: GSE198266_preprocessed_data2.csv, N_* columns, re-indexed by repaired gene symbol (prep_matrix.py)
selected.paper_input: pre-processed data: FPKM +1, log2, quantile normalized (S5.5.p1)

decisions.reason: N_* values range 0-14.7, every column has the same sorted distribution (quantile normalization; max spread 0.03 from ties), and the deposited group .mean columns equal means of the N_* columns. They are the paper's pre-processed input to the t-test. The raw *_FPKM columns in the same file are not used because the repository has no quantile-normalization transform and the authors' normalized values are deposited.

selected.analysis_type: multi-group within strata (tissue), planned exercise contrasts per age
selected.formula: ~ 0 + grp (fitted separately within SOL and within GAS)

decisions.reason: The paper's exercise question is YE vs YC and OE vs OC within each muscle (S2.3.p1, S2.4.p1). grp has four levels within a tissue; one limma model per tissue with planned contrasts uses all 12 samples of that tissue for variance estimation, never pooling levels. Tissue is a stratum. n = 3 per group.

Within a tissue every mouse contributes one sample, so there is no repeated measure to block; the mouse key only links SOL and GAS, which are never compared here. No batch, sex (all male) or other covariate is recorded; the paper adjusts for none.

selected.method: limma (moderated t, empirical Bayes) on the authors' log2(FPKM+1) quantile-normalized values, one fit per tissue

paper_route.method: independent two-sample t-test per gene (genefilter) on the 6 samples of each comparison
paper_route.reason: the repository has no per-gene t-test executor; limma on the same log-scale input is the validated alternative

deviations: limma moderated t instead of an ordinary t-test (variance shrinkage, residual variance from all 12 samples of the tissue in the primary runs)
sensitivity runs use only the two compared groups (6 samples), closer to the paper's per-comparison t-test

decisions.reason: Matrix is already log-scale (matrix-method policy: limma as-is). The paper's ordinary t-test cannot be run by a repository executor; the moderated t on identical input is the closest validated route and is declared as a deviation.

selected.deviation_note: paper rule (raw p < 0.05 and FC > 1.5) applied to limma moderated-t p-values; FDR < 0.05 reported as a separate audit rule

decisions.reason: S5.6.2.p1: p-value < 0.05 and fold change > 1.5 for within-tissue comparisons; FC 1.5 = |log2FC| > 0.5849625.
